item.title: A Simple ROI Calculator in Google Sheets: NPV, IRR, and Payback Period
item.description: Most “ROI calculator” templates floating around are a single cell dividing gain by cost. That works for a one-time, single-period return, but it falls apart the moment you have cash flows spread across multiple months or years, because it ignores when the money actually shows up. This post builds a small calculator that handles multi-period cash flows properly using NPV, IRR, and a payback period formula, and explains what each one is actually computing.
